decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core lighting range and given its own product page, the firm has already made a visible commitment and, with no clear negative market evidence in a growing industry, management would continue backing it.

Because this 2023 ceiling luminaire fits the established offer, supports the firm's broad design-led portfolio, and was publicly presented on its own page, management would be inclined to retain it and interpret any early uncertainty as temporary.
